content: I have focused on the key points and structured the information for clarity: 1. Professor David Molyneux is a Senior Professorial Fellow at the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine in Liverpool, England. 2. Dr. Zuhair Hallaj serves as a Senior Consultant on Communicable Diseases at the WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean, based in Cairo, Egypt. 3. Dr. Gerald T. Keusch is a Professor of International Health and Medicine at Boston University, located in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. 4. Dr. Pilar Ramos-Jimenez is affiliated with the Philippine NGO Council on Population, Health, and Welfare in Pasay City, Philippines. 5. Professor Donald Peter McManus is a Senior Principal Research Fellow and Head of the Molecular Parasitology Laboratory at the Queensland Institute of Medical Research in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. He is also associated with the National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia. 6. Dr. Eduardo Gotuzzo is the Director of the Instituto de Medicina Tropical “Alexander von Humboldt” at Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia in Lima, Peru. 7. Dr. Kamal Kar is the Chairman of the CLTS Foundation, based in Calcutta, India. 8. Dr. Ana Sanchez is an Associate Professor in the Department of Community Health Sciences at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada. 9. Dr. Amadou Garba is the Director of the Réseau International Schistosomose, Environnement, Aménagement et Lutte (RISEAL) in Niamey, Niger. 10. Dr. Helena Ngowi works in the Department of Veterinary Medicine and Public Health at Sokoine University of Agriculture in Morogoro, United Republic of Tanzania. 11. Dr. Sarah Cleaveland is a Reader in the Division of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at the University of Glasgow, Scotland. 12. Dr. Hélène Carabin is affiliated with the University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA. 13. Professor Barbara McPake is the Director and Professor at the Institute for International Health and Development at Queen Margaret University in Edinburgh, Scotland. 14. Dr. Margaret Gyapong is the Director of the Dodowa Health Research Centre under the Ghana Health Service in Dodowa, Ghana. 15. Professor Juan Arroyo Laguna is a Principal Professor in the Department of Health and Social Sciences at Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia in Lima, Peru. 16. Professor Sarah Atkinson is a Reader in the Department of Geography at the University of Durham, England. 17. Professor Rama Baru is a Professor at the Centre of Social Medicine and Community Health at Jawaharlal Nehru University in New Delhi, India. 18. Professor Sanaa Botros manages the Training and Consultation Unit at the Theodor Bilharz Research Institute in Imbaba, Giza, Egypt. 19. Dr. Mary Jane Cardosa is the Director of the Institute of Health and Community Medicine at the University Malaysia Sarawak in Kota, Malaysia. 20. Professor Simon Efange is a Professor of Chemistry at the University of Buea in Cameroon. 21. Dr. Vish Nene is the Director of the Biotechnology Thematic Group at the International Livestock Research Institute in Nairobi, Kenya. 22. Dr. Antonio Oliveira-Dos-Santos is the Medical Affairs Director at Genzyme in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. 23. Professor Paul Reider is a member of the Department of Chemistry at Princeton University in Princeton, New Jersey, USA. 24. Dr. Giorgio Roscigno is the former Chief Executive Officer of the Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics in Geneva, Switzerland. 25. Professor Anthony So is the Director of the Terry Sanford Institute of Public Health Policy at Duke University in Durham, North Carolina, USA. 26. Professor Ming-Wei Wang is the Director of the National Centre for Drug Screening in Shanghai, China. 27. Dr. Miguel Angel González-Block is the Executive Director of the Centre for Health Systems Research at the National Institute of Public Health in Cuernavaca, Mexico. 28. Professor Olayiwola Akinsowon Erinosho is the Executive Secretary of the Health Reform Foundation of Nigeria (HERFON) in Abuja, Nigeria. 29. Dr. Charles Collins is an Honorary Senior Research Fellow at the University of Birmingham in England. 30. Dr. Dyna Arhin is an Associate Consultant with the Public Health Action Support Team (PHAST) at the Faculty of Medicine, Imperial College London, England. 31. Dr. Abbas Bhuiya is a Senior Social Scientist and Head of the Poverty and Health Programme at the International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh (ICDDR,B) in Dhaka, Bangladesh. 32. Dr. Celia Maria de Almeida is a Senior Researcher and Professor in Health Policy and Health Systems Organization at the Escola Nacional de Saúde Pública (ENSP/FIOCRUZ) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. 33. Professor Barun Kanjilal is a Professor at the Indian Institute of Health Management Research in Jaipur, India. 34. Dr. Joseph Kasonde is the Executive Director of the Zambia Forum for Health Research in Lusaka, Zambia. 35. Dr. Dorothée Kinde-Gazard is the Minister of Health and oversees the National AIDS Control Programme (PNLS) in Cotonou, Benin. 36. Dr. Samuel Wanji is associated with the Research Foundation for Tropical Diseases and the Environment in Buea, Cameroon. 37. Professor Anthony McMichael is a Professor at the National Centre for Epidemiology and Population Health at the Australian National University in Canberra, Australia. 38. Professor Xiao-Nong Zhou is the Director of the National Institute of Parasitic Diseases at the China Centers for Disease Control in Shanghai, China. 39. Professor Corey Bradshaw is the Director of Ecological Modelling at the Environment Institute and School of Earth & Environmental Sciences at the University of Adelaide, Australia. 40. Dr. Stuart Gillespie is the Director of RENEWAL and Coordinator of the Agriculture and Health Research Platform at the International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI), Geneva, Switzerland. 41. Dr. Suad M. Sulaiman is a Health and Environment Adviser based in Khartoum, Sudan. 42. Professor James A. Trostle is a Professor of Anthropology at Trinity College in Hartford, Connecticut, USA. 43. Dr. Jürg Utzinger is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Public Health and Epidemiology at the Swiss Tropical Institute in Basel, Switzerland. 44. Professor Bruce Wilcox is the Director of the Global Health Program at the University of Hawaii in Honolulu, USA. 45. Dr. Guojing Yang is an Assistant Professor and Principal Investigator in the Department of Schistosomiasis Control at the Jiangsu Institute of Parasitic Diseases in China. This version organizes the information into concise, professional descriptions of each individual’s role and affiliation.
